## Base URL

All endpoints are served from the Rust BFF:

```
http://localhost:8090/api/v1
```

**OpenAPI spec:** the complete machine-readable contract (all 100 paths, request/response schemas, security schemes) is generated by [utoipa](https://github.com/juhaku/utoipa) from the BFF source and is available for download:

[Download openapi.json](/api-reference/openapi.json)

A live deployment also serves interactive **Swagger UI** at `/swagger-ui/` on the BFF host (e.g. [http://localhost:8090/swagger-ui/](http://localhost:8090/swagger-ui/)). This page is a curated overview — the spec is the ground truth for exact field types and enum values.

## Authentication

The API supports two Bearer credential types, passed in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Personal API tokens (`psk_…`)** — the recommended way to call the API from scripts and CI. Tokens are created per user, support optional expiry and fine-grained scopes, and are managed under `/api/v1/api-tokens` (see [API tokens](#api-tokens) below). The plaintext secret is shown exactly once at creation. A token whose scopes do not cover an operation receives `403`.

**Keycloak JWT** — a short-lived access token issued by Keycloak. The Next.js app obtains it automatically via next-auth. When calling the API directly, use the ROPC grant:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/realms/perfscale/protocol/openid-connect/token \
  -d "grant_type=password" \
  -d "client_id=perfscale-site" \
  -d "client_secret=$CLIENT_SECRET" \
  -d "username=demo@perfscale.ru" \
  -d "password=demo1234"
```

**Machine tokens (`machine_auth`)** — M2M tokens obtained from Keycloak via the `client_credentials` grant. They carry a `tenant_id` claim that binds the machine to its workspace and are intended for **agents** (machine ping, OTel ingestion), not for end-user API access.

## Billing gate

Deployments with billing enforcement enabled (`BILLING_ENFORCE=true`, e.g. perfscale.ru) require an active paid subscription. Tenants without one receive on all `/api/v1/*` operations:

**`402 Payment Required`**

```json
{
  "code": "PAYMENT_REQUIRED",
  "message": "An active paid subscription is required to use this endpoint"
}
```

Exempt endpoints (always available): `GET /api/v1/auth/me`, `POST /api/v1/contact`, `POST /api/v1/users/provision`, `GET /api/v1/tenants`, `POST /api/v1/tenants/switch`, `GET /api/v1/tenants/billing-status`, `GET /api/v1/tenants/payments`, `POST /api/v1/tenants/subscription/cancel`, `POST /api/v1/tenants/subscription/resume`, and invitation accept. On deployments where billing is disabled entirely, billing endpoints return `503` with code `BILLING_DISABLED`.

## Auth

### GET /api/v1/auth/me

Returns the identity of the currently authenticated user, decoded from the JWT.

**Response `200 OK`**

```json
{
  "sub": "a1b2c3d4-...",
  "email": "demo@perfscale.ru",
  "name": "Demo User",
  "preferred_username": "demo",
  "roles": ["member"]
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `sub` | string | Keycloak user UUID |
| `email` | string? | Email address |
| `name` | string? | Display name |
| `preferred_username` | string? | Keycloak username |
| `roles` | string[] | Realm roles assigned to the user |

## Machines

Machines are worker hosts (agents) registered in the tenant workspace that execute test runs.

| Method & path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/machines` | List machines (paginated) |
| `POST /api/v1/machines` | Register a machine manually |
| `GET /api/v1/machines/:id` | Machine details |
| `DELETE /api/v1/machines/:id` | Remove a machine (`204`) |
| `PATCH /api/v1/machines/:id/status` | Update status (`online` / `offline` / `maintenance`) |
| `POST /api/v1/machines/:id/reinstall` | Re-issue agent install script |
| `POST /api/v1/machines/:id/update-agent` | Trigger agent self-update |
| `POST /api/v1/machines/register/ssh` | Register a machine over SSH (async job) |
| `GET /api/v1/machines/register/ssh/:job_id/events` | SSH registration progress (SSE) |
| `POST /api/v1/machines/ping` | Agent heartbeat (`machine_auth`) |
| `GET /api/v1/machines/events` | Machine status events (SSE) |
| `GET /api/v1/machines/:machine_id/tasks` | Tasks executed on a machine |
| `GET /api/v1/machines/:id/libraries` | Installed libraries (paginated) |
| `POST /api/v1/machines/:id/libraries/install` | Install a library on the machine |
| `DELETE /api/v1/machines/:id/libraries/:sha256` | Remove a library |

**Machine object**

```json
{
  "id": "m_01",
  "name": "worker-node-01",
  "hostname": "worker-01.internal",
  "ip_address": "10.0.0.1",
  "os": "linux",
  "arch": "amd64",
  "cpu_cores": 8,
  "memory_gb": 16,
  "status": "online"
}
```

## Tests

Test definitions (script + tool) that can be executed on machines.

| Method & path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/tests` | List test definitions (paginated) |
| `POST /api/v1/tests` | Create a test (`201`) |
| `GET /api/v1/tests/:id` | Test details |
| `PUT /api/v1/tests/:id` | Replace name, script, or status |
| `DELETE /api/v1/tests/:id` | Delete a test definition (`204`) |

| Field | Type | Values |
|-------|------|--------|
| `tool` | enum | `k6` \| `jmeter` \| `locust` \| `artillery` \| `gatling` \| `custom` |
| `status` | enum | `draft` \| `active` \| `archived` (default: `draft`) |

## Tasks

A task is a single execution of a test on a machine.

| Method & path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/tasks` | List tasks, newest first (paginated) |
| `POST /api/v1/tasks` | Trigger a test execution (`202 Accepted`) |
| `GET /api/v1/tasks/:id` | Task details with metrics |
| `DELETE /api/v1/tasks/:id` | Cancel a pending or running task (`204`) |
| `GET /api/v1/tasks/:id/log` | Stored log of a finished run |
| `GET /api/v1/tasks/:id/otel-metrics` | Aggregated OTel metrics of the run |
| `GET /api/v1/tasks/:id/otel-timeseries` | OTel metric timeseries of the run |

**POST /api/v1/tasks — request body**

```json
{
  "testId": "t_01"
}
```

**Response `202 Accepted`**

```json
{
  "id": "task_02",
  "status": "pending"
}
```

Poll `GET /api/v1/tasks/:id` to follow progress.

**Task record**

```json
{
  "id": "task_01",
  "test_id": "t_01",
  "status": "passed",
  "p50": 142,
  "p95": 310,
  "p99": 490,
  "error_rate": 0.002,
  "requests_per_sec": 230.5,
  "total_requests": 6900,
  "started_at": "2025-01-15T10:05:00Z",
  "finished_at": "2025-01-15T10:05:30Z"
}
```

### POST /api/v1/test/run

Ad-hoc run: dispatch a test to a specific machine without creating a persistent task first. Requires `machine` and `test`; optional `configuration` and `transport` (`sse` | `ws` | `long_polling`). The response advertises the live stream URL in `stream.<machineId>.url`.

### GET /api/v1/tasks/:id/log-stream

Live log stream of a running task over **Server-Sent Events**
(`text/event-stream`). `:id` accepts the task UUID or its public id; the
caller must authenticate with the usual Bearer token.

Each `data:` frame carries one task event as JSON:

```json
data: {"type": "log", "source": "out", "text": "running (01m00.0s), 1/1 VUs"}
```

| `type` | Payload | Terminal |
|--------|---------|----------|
| `log` | `source` (`out`/`err`), `text` — one output line | no |
| `done` | `task` — the final task record with metrics | yes |
| `error` | `message` — unrecoverable dispatch error | yes |

After a terminal event the stream ends. If the run finished before you
connected (or its live stream is no longer available), the endpoint answers
immediately with a single `done` event built from the current task record.

### GET /api/v1/tasks/:id/ws

The same live stream over **WebSocket** — the alternative transport selected
with `"transport": "ws"` when starting a run (the run response then advertises
this URL in `stream.<machineId>.url`). Authentication, id resolution, and the
fallback semantics are identical to the SSE endpoint.

- Every task event is delivered as one **text message** with exactly the same
  JSON as the SSE `data:` frames above.
- After the terminal (`done`/`error`) message the server closes the socket
  with code **1000** (normal closure).
- The server pings every ~30 s and drops clients whose pong is overdue;
  answer pings with pongs (any standard WS client does this automatically).
- Unknown or cross-tenant task ids are rejected with plain `404`/`401` HTTP
  responses before the upgrade, so a failed handshake carries the JSON error
  body.

`"transport": "sse"` (default) maps to the SSE endpoint above;
`"transport": "long_polling"` is not implemented and currently falls back to
SSE.

## Triggers

Cron-based schedules that run tests automatically.

| Method & path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/triggers` | List triggers |
| `POST /api/v1/triggers` | Create a trigger (`201`) — required: `name`, `testId`, `machineId`, `cron`; optional: `timezone`, `configurationId`, `enabled`, `description` |
| `GET /api/v1/triggers/:id` | Trigger details |
| `PUT /api/v1/triggers/:id` | Update a trigger |
| `DELETE /api/v1/triggers/:id` | Delete (`204`) |
| `POST /api/v1/triggers/:id/run` | Fire a trigger immediately |

## Tenants & billing

Multi-tenancy and subscription management.

| Method & path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/tenants` | Tenants the current user belongs to |
| `POST /api/v1/tenants/switch` | Switch the active tenant (`tenantId`) |
| `GET /api/v1/tenants/limits` | Plan limits of the active tenant |
| `GET /api/v1/tenants/billing-status` | Billing status: `paid`, `plan`, `autoRenew`, `paidUntil` |
| `GET /api/v1/tenants/payments` | Payment history |
| `POST /api/v1/tenants/subscription/cancel` | Cancel auto-renewal |
| `POST /api/v1/tenants/subscription/resume` | Resume a cancelled subscription |

Billing endpoints return `503` (`BILLING_DISABLED`) where billing is not configured. `POST /api/v1/tenants/:id/payments` (payment recording) and `PUT /api/v1/tenants/:id/plan` (plan changes) are internal-only operations, not part of the public API.

## API tokens

Personal `psk_…` tokens for programmatic access (see [Authentication](#authentication)).

| Method & path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/v1/api-tokens` | List your tokens (`?all=true` lists all tenant tokens, requires `manage_api_tokens`) |
| `POST /api/v1/api-tokens` | Create a token (`201`) — plaintext returned **once** |
| `POST /api/v1/api-tokens/:id/rotate` | Rotate the secret, old value stops working immediately |
| `DELETE /api/v1/api-tokens/:id` | Revoke a token (`204`) |

**Create — request body**

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Required display name |
| `expiresAt` | string? | RFC 3339 timestamp; omit for a non-expiring token |
| `scopes` | string[]? | Fine-grained scopes; omit or `null` for full access (an empty array is rejected) |

## Error responses

All error responses follow the common `ApiError` envelope:

```json
{
  "code": "NOT_FOUND",
  "message": "Task task_99 does not exist"
}
```

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `400` | Invalid request body |
| `401` | Missing or expired token |
| `402` | Payment required — no active paid subscription (see [Billing gate](#billing-gate)) |
| `403` | Token valid but insufficient permissions — also returned when a `psk_` token's scopes don't cover the operation |
| `404` | Resource not found |
| `409` | Conflict (e.g. machine hostname already registered) |
| `500` | Internal server error |
| `503` | Feature unavailable (e.g. `BILLING_DISABLED` on deployments without billing) |
